text:
maya: quick async — onboarded kestrel-13b into staging and ran the spanish-v2 promptset sweep. seeing a tokenization nuisance: trailing punctuation gets split inconsistently, ~+3% tokenization mismatch on dev samples. putting some failing examples below

maya: ```
input: "¿Cómo estás?"
expected_normalized: "¿Cómo estás?"
tokenized: [627, 233, 78, 4, 9, 0, 123]  # splits punctuation into extra token on some seeds
```

jonah: can you paste a full failing example (raw + model output)? might be a tokenizer config mismatch between import and runtime.

maya: pasted full case to the promptset repo and linked it — https://git.internal/redwood/evals/promptsets/spanish-v2/cases.json (added under case id sp-1024). model output shows extra token '¿' encoded twice sometimes.

sara: quick remind — gating rule for tokenization drift is 2% on spanish-v2, right? if so this is above threshold, we should gate rollout.

zane: I shadowed kestrel in prod with flag kestrel-shadow-2026 and toggled canary to 1% for now. infra-bot shows a shadow deployment succeeded.

infra-bot: deploy succeeded: kestrel-13b -> shadow pool (pool-id: shd-11). Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/sha/abc123

jonah: suggestion: try running with fallback byte-level tokenization for that promptset to see if the mismatch is tokenizer or model-side. maya, can you run quick compare?

maya: yep running two eval jobs: one with normalization on (current), one forcing byte fallback. launching:
```
python tools/eval_runner.py --model kestrel-13b --promptset spanish-v2 --batches 50 --tokenizer-mode normal
python tools/eval_runner.py --model kestrel-13b --promptset spanish-v2 --batches 50 --tokenizer-mode byte_fallback
```
ETA ~20m, will paste numbers.

eval-bot: heads-up: previous import of kestrel had tokenizers generated with ICU v68; runtime uses ICU v72 on staging — potential source of differences.

sara: thanks — that points at environment mismatch. storage, did we bundle tokenizer binaries with the model bundle?

storage: quick response — model bundles include tokenizer.json but not ICU runtime. packaging note: we rely on system ICU. I can attach a tokenization shim to the bundle if needed.

maya: blocker: need the shim/artifact from storage to test the exact import-time tokenizer. storage said they'll attach it by EOD. pinged them in the model bundle PR.

jonah: I'll review PR #4822 today (normalization tweaks + test cases). leave a note if you want a pair review.

maya: thanks — added test coverage and the failing cases. also prepping rollback plan: set canary to 5% + automatic fallback to 'kestrel-13b-tokenfix' variant if spanish-v2 key metrics hit -1% accuracy.

zane: I'll set the canary and add the fallback rule in routing policy. plan to keep it blocked until we get the exact tokenizer shim.

maya: FYI running the two evals now — will post results in ~25m. today focus: finish normalization patch, collect AB samples, add gating docs.

jonah: will do CR review. sara: can you confirm gating threshold one more time?

sara: confirmed 2% drift for tokenization-sensitive promptsets. hold rollout until we have storage shim + passing AB.

maya: cool. tagging @storage — thanks for the help. :thumbsup:

storage: attaching shim to model bundle in the PR now. will comment when uploaded.

infra-bot: note: rolling canaries must be scheduled during low-traffic window (00:00-04:00 PT) unless explicitly approved.

maya: noted, we'll schedule final rollout window once tests pass.

jonah: small ask — can we add a quick CI job that runs the tokenizer consistency check on import? would avoid this cycle.

maya: agree, I'll add a lightweight `tokenizer_consistency_check.py` to the model import pipeline PR.

sara: nice. anything else?

maya: nope, will update with eval results. thanks all.
